summary: Hardened MyPortal's automatic Gitea sign-in so a stored Gitea login can never be a hand-made or malformed account. identity() now validates the stored login against the exact shape gitea_login() produces (letters, digits, . _ -, no leading or trailing punctuation, at most 30 characters, plus the user's id); because the numeric id suffix is required, a value can never be a hand-made account such as the myportal administrator. An unexpected value is logged and dropped in favour of the canonical login, so a technician always signs in as the account MyPortal makes. Added a login-shape test and a regression test for the tampered-row fallback. ENABLE_REVERSE_PROXY_AUTO_REGISTRATION is intentionally kept on, as sign_in_as relies on Gitea's auto-registration to create accounts.
